guidebook.the_four_primitives_and_weapon:
§7Welcome to The Four Primitives and Weapons.

§fThis book covers:
§7- Weapon controls
§7- Skill selection
§7- Mob info

§8Use the left/right arrows to turn pages.

§fRight click: throw
§7Launches knives in a fan pattern using the selected mode and count.

§fShift + Left click: skill screen
§7Choose mode and count (1-10).

§cNote: higher count = wider spread.
§7Snipe = 1 knife / Volley = 10 knives.

§7Cost: MP 0
§7Cooldown: 8t

§fStandard throw. Light and fast.
§7Damages enemies on hit, sticks into blocks for later retrieval.

§7Cost: MP 25/knife
§7Cooldown: 16t

§fElectric shock. Applies Slowness + Weakness on hit.
§7Effective for crowd control but MP-intensive.

§7Cost: MP 10/knife
§7Cooldown: 10t

§fBreaks wood/leaves and turns them into items.
§7Leaves drop saplings/sticks at low chance (bare-hand behavior).
§7Disappears on wood, passes through leaves.

§7MP regenerates over time (0.1/tick).
§7Max 100.

§fStun/Screw knives consume MP.
§7Cannot throw when MP is insufficient.
§7Check the bar on the left side of the screen.

§7HP: Normal
§7Attack: Melee

§fBasic early-game enemy.
§7Normal knives are sufficient.

§7HP: High
§7Attack: Strong melee

§fUpgraded soldier with better gear.
§7Stun first, then finish safely.

§7HP: Very high
§7Attack: Area

§fBoss-tier foe. Spam 10-knife volleys to bring it down.

§7When Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks is installed,
§7this mod automatically uses its mana system.

§f- MP bar shown only by Iron's HUD
§f- Stun/Screw knives consume Iron's MP
§f- Mana regen follows Iron's logic

§7No double bars, no double regen.

§7Katanas can be stored in a §fSaya (sheath) §7and worn at the hip.

§fBattou (draw): §7Pull katana from sheath and strike instantly
§fSheath: §7Return the katana to its saya

§fR key controls:
§7- Short tap (<0.5s): Instant draw/sheath
§7- Long hold (>=0.5s): Show wheel -> aim with mouse -> release to confirm

§7Put the sheath in a §fBOOK §7Curios slot or dedicated slot.

§7Nigu Shield. Right-click with correct timing
§fto parry the enemy's attack and gain §bGuard state§f.

§7While guarding: damage reduction + counter chance.
§cOn miss: acts as a regular shield.

§fFire / Thunder / Storm / Wind Step / Bubble / Darkness §7etc.
§7Right-click to cast the elemental spell.

§cEffects:
§7- AoE damage / knockback / mobility
§7- Some consume §blots of MP
§7- Creative mode ignores MP.

§7Full 4-piece sets in several colors (Normal / Green / Black / Red / Blue).

§fSet bonuses:
§7- Each color grants unique resistances
§7- Higher durability than vanilla armor

§7Craft with color-specific core material + iron ingots.

§7HP: Boss-tier
§7Attack: Melee + special

§fAn upgraded soldier boss.
§cMelee range = instant kill risk.
§7Stun + 10-knife Screw volley is the meta.

§7HP: High / Flying
§7Attack: Ranged + charge

§fThree variants (Serious / Mocker1 / Mocker2).
§7They fly fast - Homing Knives help you track them.

§7HP: Very high
§7Attack: Pull / area

§fSucks nearby entities in.
§cMelee = suicide.
§7Stay far and spam Stun knives.

§7Some mobs gain a random trait on spawn.

§fIron Wall: §7+20 armor / 1.5x max HP
§fBerserker: §7x2.5 atk / faster below 30% HP
§fSwift: §7x2.0 speed / +16 tracking
§fRegenerator: §7Permanent Regen II
§fSpinner: §7Periodic cobweb at target feet
§fCurser: §7Random debuff on hit (Wither/Blind/etc)
§fExplosive: §7Small boom on hit, big boom on death
§fUndying: §7Holds Totem of Undying

§7Enable with /gamerule distanceScaling true.
§7Mobs grow stronger with distance from spawn.

§f1 level per 500 blocks (cap 20)

§7HP:     1.0 + lv*0.15  (max 4.0x)
§7Atk:    1.0 + lv*0.10  (max 3.0x)
§7Armor:  lv*1.0         (max +20)
§7Speed:  1.0 + lv*0.02  (max 1.4x)
§7Track:  lv*2.0         (max +40)

§fKatana traits:
§7- Wide horizontal slash range
§7- Combine with a §bSaya §7for Battou draw

§fVariants:
§7- Iron / Gold / Stone §8(basic)
§7- Netherite §8(durable)
§7- Magical §8(enchanted)
§7- Others: straight sword / small / warabiteto

§fSwords with unique effects:
§7- §6Sword of Night §7: charged area slash
§7- §cRivers of Blood §7: combo buff / blood mist
§7- §ePrototype Katana §7: high-spec prototype
§7- §5Kurikaraken §7: elemental sacred blade

§7Check the tooltip when equipped.

§fOther weapons:
§7- §6Hammer §7: heavy-duty area smash
§7- §2Scythe §7: wide sweep, slow
§7- §3Rapier §7: fast thrust, pairs with parry

§7Each has its own motion. Mix and match with katanas/swords.

guidebook.the_four_primitives_and_weapon:
§7Welcome to The Four Primitives and Weapons.

§fAdds a wide variety of Japanese-style katanas plus swords,
spears, shields, bows, throwing knives, hookshots and more.

§fStrengthen weapons at the Rarity Forge,
swap motions per weapon via the skill menu,
and use the dodge system to expand combat options.

§7Next page: about skills →

§fEach weapon has swappable motions (skills).

§7• Combo — normal left click
§7• Dash attack — left click while sprinting
§7• Right click — weapon-specific action
§7• Shift + right click — guard / special

§fSkills can cost MP, have cooldowns, pull enemies,
trigger explosions, and more — mix and match.

§7Next page: how to change skills →

§fHold a weapon and press §a[K]§f to open the skill picker.

§7For each slot (combo/dash/right-click/shift+right-click),
pick a motion from the available list.

§fDodge mode is configured in Options → Controls → Dodge Settings.
§fDebug Settings can also toggle Re:Cross Hookshot logging.

§7Pages 4+ list all weapons in alphabetical order.

§7A monochrome shield. Catches attacks and deflects impact.
Lightweight yet durable.
Good pair with a two-handed sword.

§fHold right click: Guard
§fPerfect timing: Parry
§7Successful parry briefly stuns the attacker.

§7A special bracelet that suppresses gravity.
Wearer falls slowly while equipped.
Equip in Curios bracelet slot.

§fSlow fall + no fall damage
§7Sneak to switch back to normal fall.
Safe air combat / cliff traversal.

§7A blue blade that wields the gleam of lapis.
Uchigatana and tyokutou variants exist.
Releases frost-tinged slashes.

§fLeft click: combo
§fDash + left: dash slash
§fRight click: depends on selected skill
§7Press K to change skills.

§7Vanilla bow with optional bow skills.
Set via Skill Selection (K) or switch on the fly
with the Shift + Left-click wheel.

§fAvailable skills:
§7- Power Shot / Explosive / Pierce
§7- Rapid Fire / Homing / Arrow Rain
§7- Quick Draw / Heavy Blow / Wind Aura

§fHold right-click: draw (vanilla)
§fRelease: shoot → applies selected skill

§fShift + Left-click: bow skill wheel
§7Quick tap: cycle to next skill
§7Long press: open wheel → aim mouse → release to confirm

§7Default is no skill (vanilla behavior).

§7Vanilla crossbow with optional bow skills.
Uses the same skill set as the bow.
Effects apply to each arrow when multi-shot.

§fHold right-click: load
§fRight click: shoot → applies selected skill

§fShift + Left-click: bow skill wheel
§7Same feel as the bow.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fArrow damage +4, critical hit.
§7Best for single-target burst.
Ideal for sniping tough enemies.

§7Trigger: arrow impact

§fSmall explosion (radius 2) at impact.
§7No terrain damage, AoE.
Effective against groups.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fArrow pierces up to 5 targets, +1 damage.
§7Best vs lined-up enemies.
Does not pierce walls or shields.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fFires 2 additional arrows (3 total per shot).
§7Wider hit area.
All arrows follow the main trajectory.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fArrow homes onto nearest enemy within 20 blocks.
§7Only targets within 60° of view direction.
Course-correct every 4 ticks.

§7Trigger: arrow impact

§f8 arrows rain from the sky on impact point.
§7Area suppression, main arrow consumed.
Most effective outdoors.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fArrow speed x1.5.
§7Best for long-range, quick shots.
Simple velocity buff, no quirks.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fArrow damage +2.
§7Plain but steady damage buff.
All-rounder with no downside.

§7Trigger: bow/crossbow right-click shot

§fNo gravity, speed x1.5, knockback +2.
§7Flat-line shots ignore the parabolic arc.
Knockback creates distance.

§7Upgraded form of Gate. Throws multiple blades at once.
A dense convergent strike that cleaves through space.

§fRight click: multi-throw
§7Blades return after the throw.
Effective against groups.

§7A katana imbued with darkness.
Forged from wither rose and iron.
Applies brief Wither on hit.

§fLeft click: combo (dark)
§fDash + left: dark wave
§7Inflicts Wither on the target.

§7A special knife that detonates on impact.
AOE damage only — no terrain destruction.

§fRight click: throw
§7Damages everything in blast radius on impact.
Good for clearing groups.

§7A gold tyokutou that cleaves through space.
Returns to your hand after being thrown, as if alive.

§fRight click: throw
§fLeft click: combo
§7Tip points along the throw direction.

§7A katana with a golden blade.
Gorgeous but fragile.
Excellent enchantability.

§fLeft click: combo
§fDash + left: dash slash
§7Low durability — better as decoration.

§7A golden tyokutou (straight sword).
A gorgeous blade engraved with sigils.

§fLeft click: combo
§fRight click: thrust
§7Honest tyokutou-class performance.

§7A blunt weapon. Slow swings but heavy hits.
Large knockback.

§fLeft click: overhead swing
§fDash + left: ground slam (AOE)
§7Sends light enemies flying.

§7A core of immortality. Negates one fatal hit while held.
Consumed on activation.

§fAuto-triggers on lethal damage → leaves you at 1 HP
§7Used up after activation.
Safety net for boss fights.

§7A standard iron katana.
Well-rounded performance, beginner-friendly.
The rippling steel grain is beautiful.

§fLeft click: 3-hit combo
§fDash + left: dash slash
§fRight click: depends on skill
§7Press K to change skills.

§7A straight iron blade.
Specialized for thrusting.

§fLeft click: thrust combo
§fRight click: heavy thrust
§7High armor penetration.

§7A katana that flies through the air.
When thrown the blade soars on its own.

§fRight click: throw
§7Flies to the impact point and damages.
Does not return.

§7Throws knives in a fan from your inventory.
Consumes knife stacks as ammo.

§fRight click: throw
§fShift + left click: skill picker
§7Adjustable mode/count (1-10).
More knives = more spread.

§7A masterpiece named after Kurikara the dragon king.
Uchigatana and tyokutou variants exist.
Releases flame-clad slashes.

§fLeft click: flame combo
§fRight click: blazing thrust
§7Sets target on fire.

§7Blade of the trickster god.
Summons decoys to deceive enemies.

§fLeft click: combo
§fRight click: spawn decoy
§7Decoy draws enemy aggro.

§7A blade that holds moonlight.
Attack damage rises at night.

§7Mountain blade for clearing brush.
Breaks leaf blocks quickly.

§fLeft click: swing
§7+leaf break speed.
Good for exploration.

§7A katana imbued with magic.
Synergizes well with spell books.

§fLeft click: combo (magic-typed)
§7Restores a small amount of MP on hit.

§7A katana that holds fairy magic.
Light particles dance on hit.

§fLeft click: combo (light)
§fRight click: light projectile
§7Bonus damage to undead.

§7A magical potion that restores MP.
Compatible with Iron's Spellbooks.

§fRight click: drink → +50 MP
§7With Iron's Spellbooks installed,
the restore target switches to its mana.

§7Top-tier katana forged from netherite.
Resists fire and explosions.

§fLeft click: combo
§fDash + left: dash slash
§7Floats in lava / very durable.

§7A parry-focused shield.
Counter on perfect timing.

§fRight click: guard
§fJust-guard: parry → counter window
§7Press just before the enemy lands a hit.

§7A short, light ninja blade.
Fast strikes are its hallmark.

§fLeft click: rapid combo
§fDash + left: shadow slash
§7Strong against lightly-armored foes.

§7A sealing talisman. Effective against undead.
Throws a spirit slip.

§fRight click: throw a slip
§7Bonus damage vs undead.
Can be attached to a katana saya.

§7Chuzume-style hookshot — top-tier model.
Base range 80 blocks.
Fire the hook to grapple terrain or pull entities.

§fHold right click → release to fire
§fHits terrain: auto-pull to anchor point
§fHits entity/item: pull target to you
§cHeavy mobs (Ghast/Giant/Wither/Ender Dragon)
§cinstead pull YOU toward them
§fSneak while pulling: cancel
§fSneak in air: float (resets fall damage)
§7Higher rarity = longer range / lower cooldown / longer float.

§7Chuzume-style hookshot — entry-level model.
Base range 60 blocks.
Cheaper to craft than the Ultimte variant.

§fControls and behavior identical to Ultimte.
§7Trades range for cheaper iron-based recipe.
Great starter hookshot.

§7A replica of the Sword of Light.
Slightly weaker than the original.

§fLeft click: light combo
§7Bonus damage vs undead.

§7A cursed katana that drinks blood.
The blade sharpens with every kill.

§fLeft click: combo (inflicts bleed)
§fRight click: blood wave
§7Hits stack to increase damage.

§7A reaper's scythe. One sweep covers a wide area.
Catches multiple enemies.

§fLeft click: horizontal sweep (AOE)
§fDash + left: spinning attack
§7Excellent when surrounded.

§7A small one-handed sword.
Lightweight and easy to handle.

§7A katana shaped from stone.
Plain but tough.

§7Blade of the night.
Glows deep purple, blends into shadow.

§fLeft click: combo
§fRight click: dark wave
§7More damage at night / in low light.

§7A standard throwing knife.
Light, fast, with a clean trajectory.

§fRight click: throw
§7Vanishes on enemy hit, sticks to blocks for retrieval.
MP 0 / cooldown 8t.
§7A holy bell that breaks an Undead Army.

§fRight click: ring the bell
§7Ends an active Undead Army event.
Emergency safety item.

§7An ancient blade with a fern-shaped hilt.
No curve — straight clean lines.

§fLeft click: combo
§fRight click: thrust
§7Old-style martial motions.

§7Forged from wither bones.
Applies Wither effect on hit.

§fLeft click: combo (applies Wither)
§7Drains target HP over time.
Great for boss fights.

jei.the_four_primitives_and_weapons.info:
§6Raw Lacquer
Tapped from any log.
§f- Flint§r : right-click a log (not consumed)
§f- Glass Bottle§r : right-click a log (bottle used)
Refine with §0black dye -> Jet-black Lacquer§r , §cred dye -> Vermilion Lacquer§r .
Apply to a saya for Tame-nuri; + gravel for Stone-grain.

§8Jet-black Lacquer
Made from Raw Lacquer + black dye.
Crafting: saya + this -> Black Roiro finish.
+ Glowstone Dust -> Mirror-black (Roiro) finish.

§cVermilion Lacquer
Made from Raw Lacquer + red dye.
Crafting: saya + this -> Vermilion lacquer finish.

§6Saya (Sheath)
Craft with planks to get that wood's grain finish.
Base: planks->wood / leather->cloth / flint->carved / rayskin->rayskin
Lacquer: black->roiro(+glowstone=mirror) / red->vermilion / raw->tame(+gravel=stone-grain)
saya + honeycomb -> back to plain lacquer
Base color: saya + dye (table) or dip in a colored cauldron
